lambda_definition: first moment of bit inversions per second over the full array; NOT parent or ERR rate
partitions: non-H exclusive remainder of aggregate LET, includes He; no separate He addition
proton_mechanism_separation: energy partition only; within-band mechanism fractions UNKNOWN

design_probability.definition: Pr[S2_actual(T)>S2_design | specified physical model and mission class]

union_budget_example.scope: only if these are genuine scalar bounds over the same mission and all other conditions fixed; not available here

parameter_rules.exclusive_LET: q*LET_export, 0<=q<=1; response-weighted apportionment assumption, not species identification
parameter_rules.subbin_variance: S2_true = S2_300s + sum integral(lambda-lambda_binmean)^2; no finite upper without an extra bound
parameter_rules.Dstar_and_ERR: separate unknown inputs; never derived from sigma_bit

profile_model.chronology: nonoverlapping packed RDS histories; remaining time uses outside-mask moments
profile_model.H_baseline: p10 removed proportionally from bands; constant COSRAD GCR added
profile_model.unknown_ion_correlation: main envelope uses Cauchy/peak-integral cap; sensitivity varies extra event overlap
profile_model.statistical_intervals: order statistics MC only, fixed empirical population; no physical coverage

differences_from_R0A.accepted_scope: conditional declared Lambda/Theta, not unconditional physical coverage
differences_from_R0A.response: full experimental proton curve; total-bit LET without residual fr subtraction
differences_from_R0A.geometry: proton factor1 in main sensitivity model vs historical0.5
differences_from_R0A.joint_probability: not established by marginal Pi=.1 exports
